why.org_b:finding:01050: Critical Log4Shell vulnerability with maximum CVSS and EPSS on an internet-facing asset.

reasoning: The organization's single crown-jewel warehouse datastore requires analyzing internet-facing assets and paths. Finding org_b:finding:01050 represents a critical, exploited Log4Shell vulnerability on an internet-facing host that poses immediate risk. Fixing this critical KEV finding secures the primary entry point identified in the scan.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = o.dst
JOIN edges of_v ON of_v.src = f.id AND of_v.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = of_v.dst
WHERE v.kev = true OR v.cvss >= 9.0
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  z.trust AS zone_trust
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = o.dst
JOIN edges iz ON iz.src = a.id AND iz.type = 'IN_ZONE'
JOIN zones z ON z.id = iz.dst
JOIN edges of_v ON of_v.src = f.id AND of_v.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = of_v.dst
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT DISTINCT f.id, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, a.hostname
FROM edges e_ex
JOIN assets a ON a.id = e_ex.dst
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = a.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN findings f ON f.id = e_on.src
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_of.dst
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  f.id AS finding_id,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  a.hostname,
  ds.id AS datastore_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON a.id = e_on.dst
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_of.dst
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = a.id AND e_reach.type = 'CAN_REACH'
JOIN assets a_target ON a_target.id = e_reach.dst
JOIN edges e_hold ON e_hold.src = a_target.id AND e_hold.type = 'HOLDS'
JOIN datastores ds ON ds.id = e_hold.dst
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true AND ds.sensitivity = 'crown'
LIMIT 20;
